summary: Modern, sleek, high-conversion landing page for Platon (18 y.o., Samara) — turnkey websites and business mobile apps delivered within 1 week powered by AI & modern engineering. Crisp white and electric/deep blue palette, buttery smooth motion with motion/react, interactive modal with Telegram, VK, and Max icons, interactive project cost/timeline calculator, high-impact bento showcases, and personal trust bio.

entry_surfaces./: split dynamic hero: left brand positioning + value proposition + primary 'Связаться со мной' CTA; right interactive interactive service switcher card (Сайты vs Приложения) with dynamic preview

sections.name: Главный экран (Hero Section)

sections.name: Почему до 1 недели? ИИ + Экспертиза (Process Section)
sections.description: 4-step animated flow detailing how AI accelerators + custom architecture speed up production 5x without losing quality: 1. Анализ и генерация концепта (День 1), 2. Дизайн и прототип (День 2-3), 3. AI-разработка & интеграции (День 4-5), 4. Тестирование и запуск (День 6-7).

sections.name: Калькулятор проекта и сроков
sections.description: Interactive widget letting clients select project type (Лендинг, Корпоративный сайт, Web App, Мобильное приложение), add features (AI-ассистент, Онлайн-оплата, Личный кабинет, Анимации) to get instant estimated cost and delivery timeline with a direct 'Заказать' action.

Совмещаю скорость нейросетей с ручным контролем качества кода и дизайна.'), tech stack badges, key metrics (50+ проектов, 100% соблюдение дедлайнов, 24/7 связь).

sections.name: Частые вопросы (FAQ)
sections.description: Accordions covering pricing, guarantee of delivery within 7 days, support, domain/hosting setup, source code ownership.

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts: edit frontend in /app/frontend/src. Theme CSS is /app/frontend/src/index.css.

Configure fonts in /app/frontend/src/index.css: import '@fontsource-variable/manrope', '@fontsource/ibm-plex-sans', and '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'. Set --font-heading to Manrope Variable and --font-sans to IBM Plex Sans.
Ensure complete Russian copy with natural, high-converting phrasing ('Лендинги и приложения для бизнеса за 7 дней с помощью AI').
Implement the 'Связаться со мной' popup dialog using shadcn Dialog with custom branded cards for Telegram, VK, and Max icons with direct click/copy actions and data-testid attributes.
Build the interactive Project Calculator widget letting clients pick options and see real-time price & deadline estimate.
Add Platon's Bio section with photo, bio details (18 лет, Самара, разработка под ключ), tech badges, and credibility markers.
Incorporate motion animations with motion/react for smooth entry transitions and micro-interactions.
Always ensure all buttons, inputs, links, and major headings have appropriate data-testid tags.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_ai_slop: Do not make generic centered cards with washed-out gradients. Use crisp borders, subtle glows, asymmetric bento layouts, high-contrast typography, and thoughtful Russian copywriting.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.spacing: Generous spacing (p-8, p-12, py-20 to py-28 for major sections) with strong visual hierarchy.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.toasts: Use sonner for instant feedback on copy/contact actions.
